_readme: Per-unit translation policy for en/. Keys: '<file>' (whole page) or '<file>#<section id>'. Values: translate (default) | localize (adapt Taiwan-specific content for a global reader; must add a 'Note:' callout) | transcreate (rewrite for the audience; sales.html) | rewrite (prompts that assume Chinese output) | skip (excluded; card shows 'Chinese only'). Anything not listed = translate.

sales.html.brief: Overseas edition: no TWD, no Taiwan-only framing, real contact channel; Option A (self-hosted) / Option B (managed by WoowTech). Prices, currency, CTA and contact channel are placeholders until the business brief arrives.

prompts.html.brief: Prompts must instruct the AI to answer in English; keep CLI/API/UI strings verbatim; state the true prompt count.

skills.html.brief: Full translation; any prompt demanding Traditional Chinese output becomes English-only.
